decisions.reason: The frozen atom asks which clearing/publication and handler sites should be reviewed. The answer precisely cites the dispatcher clearing/publication callsite and declared handler; the actual ClearDomainEvents body was also fully displayed in view023 (BaseEntity.cs1-31), which the reviewer independently checked.
